sentences.sk: V pondelok popoludní ide Anna na poštu.
sentences.en: On Monday afternoon Anna goes to the post office.

sentences.sk: V taške má malý balík pre svoju sestru.
sentences.en: She has a small parcel for her sister in her bag.

sentences.sk: Sestra býva v inom meste a budúci týždeň má narodeniny.
sentences.en: Her sister lives in another town and has a birthday next week.

sentences.sk: Anna jej chce poslať knihu a pohľadnicu.
sentences.en: Anna wants to send her a book and a postcard.

sentences.sk: Pred poštou stojí niekoľko ľudí.
sentences.en: Several people are standing in front of the post office.

sentences.sk: Anna vojde dnu a vezme si číslo.
sentences.en: Anna goes inside and takes a number.

sentences.sk: Na obrazovke vidí číslo dvadsaťtri.
sentences.en: She sees the number twenty-three on the screen.

sentences.sk: Anna má číslo dvadsaťpäť, preto chvíľu čaká.
sentences.en: Anna has number twenty-five, so she waits a little while.

sentences.sk: Potom príde k okienku a pozdraví pracovníčku.
sentences.en: Then she goes to the counter and greets the postal worker.

sentences.sk: Povie: „Chcem poslať tento balík do Košíc.“
sentences.en: She says, “I want to send this parcel to Košice.”

sentences.sk: Pracovníčka sa spýta na adresu.
sentences.en: The postal worker asks for the address.

sentences.sk: Anna napíše adresu na balík.
sentences.en: Anna writes the address on the parcel.

sentences.sk: Potom položí balík na váhu.
sentences.en: Then she puts the parcel on the scale.

sentences.sk: Pracovníčka povie, že poštovné stojí štyri eurá.
sentences.en: The postal worker says that postage costs four euros.

sentences.sk: Anna zaplatí kartou a dostane potvrdenie.
sentences.en: Anna pays by card and gets a receipt.

sentences.sk: Na potvrdení je číslo balíka.
sentences.en: The parcel number is on the receipt.

sentences.sk: Anna si potvrdenie dá do peňaženky.
sentences.en: Anna puts the receipt in her wallet.

sentences.sk: Vonku zavolá sestre, ale o balíku jej nič nepovie.
sentences.en: Outside she calls her sister, but she says nothing to her about the parcel.

sentences.sk: Chce, aby to bolo prekvapenie.
sentences.en: She wants it to be a surprise.

sentences.sk: Sestra sa poteší, keď balík dostane.
sentences.en: Her sister will be happy when she receives the parcel.

glossary.note: Masculine noun for a parcel sent through the post.
Accusative singular of the feminine noun pohľadnica.
Here Anna takes a queue number. This perfective verb has future meaning in the present-shaped form.
Dative singular after k (to or toward).
Accusative singular of the feminine noun adresa.
Accusative singular; here it means the scale used to weigh the parcel.
Neuter noun for the cost of sending something by post.
Neuter noun; here it is the receipt from the post office.
Neuter noun. Anna wants the parcel to surprise her sister.

questions.explanationEn: Anna wants to send her sister a book and a postcard.
The postal worker says that postage costs four euros.

questions.promptSk: Prečo Anna sestre o balíku nič nepovie?

options.text: Anna zabudla, čo je v balíku.

questions.explanationEn: Anna keeps the parcel secret because she wants it to be a surprise.
